project.name: Kin
project.summary: A relationship-first private messenger that helps people preserve, personalize, and rediscover meaningful moments together.
project.ai_usage: AI was used as a development collaborator, not inside private relationship conversations. Kin keeps memory creation explicit and deterministic.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped translate the PRD into the Expo, Supabase, and RevenueCat implementation; develop test-driven slices; review privacy and billing boundaries; verify deployments; and prepare the submission assets and demo.
